body.p: During a conflict, the Git Staging view shows a state label (for example, Merging...).

During a merge conflict, the Git History view shows an amber Start (Mine) label next to the current commit and an Incoming (Theirs) label next to the merge source commit. The view also visualises the merge source coming into the current branch by drawing a dashed grey line from the merge source to the current branch's Uncommitted changes node.
During a cherry-pick conflict, a Cherry-picked commit label appears next to the cherry-picked commit.
During a revert conflict, a Reverted commit label appears next to the commit being reverted.
